destinations.name: Yancheng
destinations.coordinates_source: candidates.json (Yancheng Water Street point, city centre); re-resolve from OSM place=city
destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage page "Yancheng" names the coast and birdwatching (counted source for Coastal Wetlands, Huanghai Forest Park, Salt Museum); Yancheng Coastal Wetlands and Dafeng Milu are the UNESCO/headline draws.
destinations.reason: Prefecture-named coast region: 6 kept spots (Yellow Sea wetlands, Milu deer, Tiaozini, Dongtai forest and old town, salt museum) with the wetlands as the draw. Considered a "Yellow Sea Wetlands" destination or standalone: the wetland places (Coastal Wetlands, Dafeng, Tiaozini, Huanghai Forest) are ~60-120 km apart, a single wetlands name overlaps the Yancheng Coastal Wetlands spot itself, and Wikivoyage groups them under Yancheng, so Yancheng is the traveller-used name. Large span because the draws lie 50-75 km out from the city; flagged for owner to reshape if preferred.
